info.title: Kling 4.0 Image Generation Task - Submit Task
info.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-series, or image-to-series task via `/kling/image-generation`.

post.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-series, or image-to-series task via `/kling/image-generation`. Single mode generates multiple independent images; series mode generates a related set of images.

contents.text: Generate a 3D animation style character poster, warm lighting, simple background.

Using the puppy in @dog as the main character, generate four connected 3D animation style story images: walking into a cafe, sitting by the window, smelling the coffee, saying goodbye at the door. Keep the puppy's coat color, appearance, and visual style consistent.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

type.description: Material type: prompt (`prompt`), reference image (`refer_image`), or element (`element`).

text.description:
Prompt content, required when `type=prompt`.
- Up to 50,000 characters for pure English, 21,000 characters for pure non-English
- Mixed input must satisfy: English characters/50000 + non-English characters/21000 ≤ 1
- Reference images or elements can be referenced with `@<id>`

url.description:
Reference image, required when `type=refer_image`. Accepts an image URL or Base64 content; the URL must be accessible.
- Supported formats: .jpg / .jpeg / .png
- Each image must be under 30 MB, at least 300 px in width and height, with an aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2

element_id.description: Element ID generated by the system, required when `type=element`. You can retrieve it via the element query API. Only multi-image elements (created from images) are supported.

id.description: Material index ID used to reference the material in the prompt via `@<id>`. Must be unique within the same task.

result_type.description:
Result type.
- `single`: independent images, generate multiple with `n`
- `series`: related image set; images in the same group share `group_id` and are returned in order

n.description: Number of independent images in single mode. Ignored when `result_type=series`; use `series_amount` instead.

series_amount.description: Number of images in the series, either [2,10] or `auto`. `auto` decides 2–10 images based on the input and consumes concurrency equal to the actual number generated.

resolution.description:
Image resolution. Applies to both single and series results.
- `2k`: 2K HD
- `4k`: 4K HD
- `8k`: 8K ultra HD

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. `auto` means the ratio is determined from the input. Applies to both single and series results.

callback_url.description: Callback URL for task results. When configured, the server notifies you whenever the task status changes.

external_task_id.description:
Custom task ID.
- It does not override the system-generated task ID, but can be used to query the task
- Must be unique per user

watermark_info.description: Whether to also generate a watermarked result. Configured with `enabled`; custom watermarks are not supported.

enabled.description: `true` generates a watermarked result, `false` does not.

contents.description:
Materials for generation, such as prompts, reference images, and elements. Must include a non-empty `type=prompt` item.
- Images plus elements are limited to 10 in total; the prompt does not count toward this limit
- The order of prompts, reference images, and elements is the analysis order

code.description: Error code; 0 means success. See the error code documentation for details.

request_id.description: Request tracking ID generated by the system for troubleshooting.

id.description: System task ID generated by the platform.

status.description: Task status: submitted, processing, succeeded, or failed.

create_time.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

update_time.description: Task update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: Custom task ID specified at creation, if any.
